source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
3. Select the section (as defined in section 2.2, "Sections") in whose description the corresponding description appears. All other sections are not marked.
4. Note:
5. click on "more details" to get the details of the test. For example, if the test records show a failure at position 25, the "more details" box will have a "failed at position 25" message on the bottom right.
6. The first row of the "more details" box displays the type of product, the manufacturer or the supplier of the product, the date of the test, and the test result.
7. The test records sheet is designed to be a record of tests performed in a test laboratory and its authorization is the property of the UMSC. When one of the records are removed from the sheet, the note will also be removed from the record. A new note should be formed before
